purpose: Headless whole-file build of the genuine linuxdoom-1.10 in-process mixer (i_sound.c with w_wad.c, z_zone.c and sounds.c) behind a declared fake OSS device, driven by start lists. The expected sample streams come from the genuine code only, never from Rust output and never from the independent model (tools/reference/m5c_mixer_model.py), which is a second check. No audio device is opened.

configuration.sound: integrated (doomdef.h:84 commented out; decision T2, recommended value, still open)
configuration.handles: addsfx: 100, 101, ... from a static unsigned short (i_sound.c:271, 335-340)
configuration.process: fresh: every mixer global zero (static storage, i_sound.c:84-151), handlenums 0

variant_notes.address: run with ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 (leak detection disabled; not LeakSanitizer coverage); -fno-sanitize=alignment because z_zone.c rounds block sizes to 4 (z_zone.c:195) while the LP64 memblock_t needs 8-byte alignment

strict32.note: config and errno adapters only, no ABI adapter (ILP32 target); needs a 32-bit toolchain; run only by m5c_mixer_reference.py --strict32 and never required

config_adapters.reason: Selects the in-process (integrated) sound configuration. With SNDSERV defined (doomdef.h:84, seen by i_sound.c through i_sound.h:26 and i_sound.c:59) I_InitSound starts the external sndserver (i_sound.c:740-757), I_StartSound writes to its pipe and returns the sfx id (i_sound.c:482-489) and D_DoomLoop never calls I_UpdateSound (d_main.c:396-400), so the mixer this driver runs never runs. The source offers this configuration itself (doomdef.h:76-85: "Default is synchronous"); SNDINTR stays undefined as shipped (doomdef.h:85). Owner decision T2 (recommended: integrated) is still open; the mixer exists only in this configuration.

errno_adapters.reason: myioctl (i_sound.c:159-175) declares errno itself; with <errno.h> included (next adapter) the macro would turn this declaration into a conflicting declaration of __errno_location, so it becomes a comment. errno is read only if an ioctl fails (i_sound.c:168-174), which the fake device never does.

glibc declares errno thread-local in <errno.h>; the plain `extern int errno;` of i_sound.c:166 does not link against it (observed in Phase 1, section 1.3.10). Including <errno.h> gives myioctl the C library's errno.

abi_adapters.reason: Z_ChangeTag: the owner test truncates the 64-bit user pointer to 32 bits, so a valid owner whose address has small low 32 bits (observed under ASan on the CI runner: W_CacheLumpNum re-caching the one patch lump) raises "an owner is required for purgable blocks"; the 32-bit original compares the whole pointer, which uintptr_t does on LP64 (stdint.h comes from -include on the command line).

stubs.reason: the tic counter; the driver sets it to each start's GAMETIC before I_StartSound, as G_Ticker runs with gametic = t (d_net.c:745-746); read by addsfx (i_sound.c:276, 348) and I_SoundIsPlaying (i_sound.c:520)
written by I_SetSfxVolume (i_sound.c:434), which nothing calls here; the mixer never reads it (volume reaches it only as an argument of I_StartSound)
written by I_SetMusicVolume (i_sound.c:441), which nothing calls here; music is out of scope
formats the message and longjmps back to the driver, which writes an x row and stops the run (vanilla prints it and exits)
*size = mb_used MiB (6, i_system.c:51, unless --zone-mb) and malloc, as vanilla; the zone size moves addresses only

behaviour: Header: m5c_fakesnd/linux/soundcard.h stands for <linux/soundcard.h> (i_sound.c:45) and declares only the seven names i_sound.c uses (i_sound.c:775-789), with the values of the Linux UAPI OSS header.
open: "/dev/dsp" with O_WRONLY (i_sound.c:770) returns fd 1000 and touches no device; any other "/dev/" path aborts; every other path (the WAD files, w_wad.c:163) goes to the real open.

ioctl: accepted only on fd 1000 (myioctl, i_sound.c:159-175, at i_sound.c:776, 777, 781, 784, 786, 789); records SETFRAGMENT, SPEED, STEREO and SETFMT; GETFMTS answers AFMT_S16_LE so the genuine SETFMT branch runs (i_sound.c:788-789); unknown requests abort; it never fails, so myioctl's exit path is not reached.
write: accepted only on fd 1000 (I_SubmitSound, i_sound.c:669): the 2,048 bytes go to the driver, which digests them; any other fd aborts.
close: fd 1000 (I_ShutdownSound, i_sound.c:725) is counted; other fds (w_wad.c:225) go to the real close.

sigaction, setitimer: referenced only by I_SoundSetTimer and I_SoundDelTimer (i_sound.c:941-985), called only with SNDINTR (i_sound.c:720-722, 762-765), which stays undefined (doomdef.h:85): they abort.

directives.config integrated: required before the first row: the handle convention of the run that made the list (decision T2); any other value is refused, because the in-process mixer exists only in the integrated configuration
directives.tics N: optional: run at least tics 0..N-1 (the session length); default 0
directives.s TIC SEQ GAMETIC SFX VOL SEP PITCH PRIO: one I_StartSound call: the session tic, the call order (the pair TIC SEQ strictly increases down the list), gametic at the call, the five arguments exactly as s_sound.c passes them (s_sound.c:389-394), and the handle the sound-logic run received, or "-"; the driver writes an m row when the genuine handle differs
directives.n COUNT TIC SEQ GAMETIC SFX VOL SEP PITC: harness only: COUNT identical starts with call orders SEQ..SEQ+COUNT-1, echoed as one sn row (the handle wrap)
directives.g TIC SEQ SFX: harness only: one call of the genuine I_GetSfxLumpNum (i_sound.c:451-456), the lookup of s_sound.c:364-365

start_list.domain: SFX 1..NUMSFX-1 (the driver indexes S_sfx with it; s_sound.c:277 also passes NUMSFX, refusal T11 item 3); PITCH 0..255 unless --probe (s_sound.c clamps it, s_sound.c:332-335, 342-345; steptable has 256 entries); VOL and SEP are passed as given (out-of-range values reach the genuine I_Error of i_sound.c:364-368).
start_list.comments: lines whose first non-blank character is # are ignored

schedule.ticbuffers: Recommended reading of decision T5 (open): after the starts of tic t (counted from the first tic of the session), mix every buffer k not yet mixed with 512*k < 315*(t+1), each by one genuine I_UpdateSound and I_SubmitSound; buffer k is mixed after tic floor(512k/315), none or one per tic, 315 buffers per 512 tics, the first after tic 0. A start takes effect in the next buffer mixed (the original mixes after all tics of a loop pass, d_main.c:389-405). The compared signal is the sequence of mixed buffers, not the device output.
schedule.pertic: One genuine I_UpdateSound and I_SubmitSound after every tic (the singletics loop, d_main.c:375-405): 512 frames per tic, 1.625 times the real-time rate. Kept only so that this reading can be reproduced; never the source of a golden.

driver_behaviour: Start-up in the genuine order: Z_Init (d_main.c:1018); W_InitMultipleFiles over the --wad files in order (d_main.c:1021); I_InitSound (I_Init, d_main.c:1101, i_system.c:107-110), which opens the fake device and loads every non-linked sfx 1..108 with the genuine getsfx (i_sound.c:799-813); I_SetChannels (S_Init, d_main.c:1107, s_sound.c:170), which builds steptable and vol_lookup (i_sound.c:396-424).

Per tic t = 0, 1, ...: every start-list row of tic t in list order; for a start, gametic = GAMETIC, then the genuine I_StartSound (SFX, VOL, SEP, PITCH, PRIO); then the schedule mixes buffers. The run continues after the last row and the last of the N tics until every mixer channel is idle at a tic boundary, or until --max-buffers (x limit row).

The driver only reads i_sound.c's globals (channels, channelsend, channelhandles, channelids, channelstep, lengths, steptable, vol_lookup, the volume row pointers, S_sfx[].data) to write its rows; it never writes them. The mixing channel of a start is the channel whose handle the call changed.
I_Error (the stub) longjmps to the driver, which writes an x row and stops, as the genuine game exits; the genuine I_ShutdownSound (i_system.c:119) then runs if I_InitSound completed.

Raw samples are written only with --raw FILE (a scratch path, never committed): the bytes exactly as the fake write received them, little-endian signed 16-bit, left first (mixbuffer is native shorts, i_sound.c:112, 565-567; the device is set to S16_LE, i_sound.c:788-789).
Test-only: --perturb-byte N flips bit 0 of stream byte N before it is digested; --probe accepts a pitch outside 0..255 (the declared probe of i_sound.c:495). Neither changes genuine code text.
The zone is 6 MiB (vanilla mb_used, i_system.c:51) unless --zone-mb is given; it moves addresses only, which only the short-lump witnesses can see.

golden_row_kinds.h: DOOM-M5C-MIXER-v1 schedule S frames 512: the header
golden_row_kinds.d: opens O ioctls I fragment 0xF speed S stereo T fmt 0xM: the fake device after I_InitSound (device glue; not written by the model)
golden_row_kinds.T: steptable|vol_lookup SHA256: SHA-256 of the genuine table as little-endian int32
golden_row_kinds.L: COUNT SHA256: SHA-256 of the COUNT l rows (each with its newline), whether or not they are printed
golden_row_kinds.l: SFX LEN SHA256: lengths[SFX] and SHA-256 of the LEN padded data bytes, or - when S_sfx[SFX].data is NULL (with --lumps)
golden_row_kinds.P: SFX SIZE PADDED PAD OF128 own|fallback: a loaded sfx whose lump size - 8 differs from its padded length, or whose ds lump is missing so getsfx used dspistol (with --lumps); PAD padding bytes, OF128 of them equal to 128
golden_row_kinds.s: TIC SEQ GAMETIC SFX VOL SEP PITCH PRIO > HANDLE SLOT STEP LVOL RVOL BEFORE PREV FREED: one start as given and what the genuine code did: the handle returned, the mixer channel, channelstep, the left and right vol_lookup rows, the occupancy mask before the call (hex), the sfx that occupied SLOT before the call or -, the other channels the call freed (comma-separated) or -
golden_row_kinds.m: TIC SEQ EXPECTED GOT: the start list's HANDLE differs from the genuine handle
golden_row_kinds.o: TIC SEQ SFX: the started non-linked sfx has padded length 0, so its one mixed frame reads one byte past its 8-byte zone block (i_sound.c:230-247, 591, 606): a layout-dependent start, refused by the model (decision T11)
golden_row_kinds.sn: TIC SEQ COUNT GAMETIC SFX VOL SEP PITCH PRIO > FIRST LAST HSHA SSHA MASK: an n row: the first and last handle, SHA-256 of the handles and of the slots (one decimal and a newline each), the occupancy mask after the last
golden_row_kinds.g: TIC SEQ SFX > LUMP: the genuine I_GetSfxLumpNum result
golden_row_kinds.b: K TIC SHA256 MASK: buffer K, mixed after tic TIC: SHA-256 of the 2,048 bytes I_SubmitSound wrote, and the occupancy mask after it was mixed (hex)
golden_row_kinds.r: N KLAST TICLAST: the previous b row's digest and mask repeat for N more buffers, the last being KLAST, mixed after tic TICLAST
golden_row_kinds.x: TIC SEQ MESSAGE | init MESSAGE | limit - MESSAGE: I_Error at a start or a lookup, at init, or the buffer limit; the run stops
golden_row_kinds.q: closes C writes W: the fake device after the genuine I_ShutdownSound (device glue; not written by the model)
golden_row_kinds.z: NBUF SHA256: the number of buffers and SHA-256 of the whole stream
